description: available's bundles (spec §15.5): each after the source's items, ✓ when the user or the project config declares it, its line followed by one more – its members, expanded through an included bundle and with an entry of another source as written, sorted, joined by `, `; `(no items)` when none matches; or `error:` and why it does not expand: a key bundle files do not have, an include cycle, an address config load would refuse as a source (k115), both .yaml and .yml. --json gives members and the bundle's own vars, or the error; with --project-dir the home the project's declaration no longer counts.
